title: Simple service desk model
goal: Build a minimal service-desk model distinguishing customer, service and request facts.
prerequisites: 1c-enterprise.a 4; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
outcomes: Build a minimal service-desk model distinguishing customer, service and request facts.
Draw three entities and two relationships.
CreateC1, S1, R1 on a copy.
sections: A customer exists before and after individual requests; a service describes an offering; a request records an occurrence in time. Repeating customer text in each request creates duplicates and widespread edits after a name change. A catalog reference separates persistent identity from recurring operations.

Start assembly with one complete operator route:select customer/service, enter duration, save and find the request again. Add report variants andUIimprovements afterwards. This ties objects to actions and exposes missing references or fields early, rather than accumulating disconnected screens. Every object should support a named workflow and a measurable persistence check.
Minimal fields must still be sufficient

The teaching core needs customer and service codes/names plus a document with references, date, minutes and status. Real phone numbers, addresses and identity documents are unnecessary. Associate each field with a workflow and persistence criterion; otherwise the model grows without testable benefit.

Catalogs represent reusable entities; documents represent individual requests. One customer can have many requests and one service many customers. Test that multiplicity synthetically. Creating a new equal-named customer for every request breaks the model even when totals match. Check catalog counts and reference identity separately from arithmetic and appearance.

A request selects an existing customer and service; an enumeration supplies allowed statuses. Deleting a referenced customer is not an isolated list cleanup. Specify inactive-customer and historical-document behavior. The foundation course can use marking and reference checks without claiming an industrial archival mechanism.

Usable forms do not replace write rules. Invalid minutes must reject through alternative input routes, and correcting one field must preserve other input. After rejection, perform a valid operation, close and reopen the document. This verifies bothUIutility and durable state rather than merely the ability to display an error.

Follow createcustomer→createservice→createrequest→findrequest→obtaintotal. Record identity and successful reread at each step. Change the customer’s displayed name and confirm the request still references the same item. This tests model cohesion rather than merely collecting attractive screens.

A complete teaching system explains each reported number through source documents and an independent small-data sum. Change one document in a fresh copy and verify recalculation, then reread the source to prove independence. Bind changes and snapshots to work IDs. Matching an infobase name never authorizes overwriting a prior submission.

quiz.question: Where is an individual request fact stored?
quiz.explanation: An event has its own identity and date.

quiz.question: Why references instead of repeated names?
quiz.explanation: Names may change while keys remain.

quiz.question: What data does the teaching desk need?
quiz.explanation: The workflow is testable without real data.

review: Build a minimal service-desk model distinguishing customer, service and request facts.
Explain which negative case distinguishes a correct solution from a superficially similar one.
